title: Points Held Back for Open TechWorks Work on a Circle Release
content:
## Points held back for work

Points on a Northbeam Circle Membership are held back against what the member owes on the agreement the profile
holds with Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair, each amount taken at the tier's value per hundred
points.

| Standing of the agreement | What stands on it | Points held back for work |
|---|---|---|
| Completed | Service charges outstanding | Those outstanding charges taken at the tier's value per hundred points |
| Scheduled, dispatched or held for parts | Labour charged in the month ending on the handling day | That labour taken at the same rate |
| Completed with nothing outstanding, or scheduled, dispatched or held for parts with no labour charged in that month | — | None |

Where the agreement the profile holds stands completed and service charges stand outstanding on it, the points
held back for work are those outstanding charges taken at the tier's value per hundred points. Where that
agreement stands scheduled, dispatched or held for parts and labour was charged on it in the month ending on
the handling day, the points held back for work are that labour taken at the same rate. Where neither of those
holds, no points are held back for work, and 0 points are taken off on this account.

## The two readings do not overlap

The first reading looks at an agreement standing completed and at the charges outstanding on it, whatever their
age. The second looks at an agreement standing scheduled, dispatched or held for parts and only at the labour
charged in the month ending on the handling day, so labour charged two months ago does not reach it.

## Cases

An agreement standing completed with 262.00 of service charges outstanding holds back the points 262.00 is
worth at the tier's value per hundred points. An agreement standing completed with nothing outstanding holds
back nothing, even where labour was charged on it last month. An agreement standing scheduled with 96.00 of
labour charged in the month ending on the handling day holds back the points 96.00 is worth at that same
rate.
